bootcmd=ubi part ubi; if test "x${upgrade_slot}" != x; then setenv slot ${upgrade_slot}; setenv upgrade_slot; saveenv; echo Trying upgraded slot ${slot}; run bootslot_one; fi; setenv slot ${bootslot}; run bootslot_one; if test "${bootslot}" = b; then setenv slot a; else setenv slot b; fi; echo Slot ${bootslot} failed, trying slot ${slot}; run bootslot_one
bootdelay=1
baudrate=115200
bootfile=uImage
bootslot=a
loadaddr=0xc0700000
mtdids=nand0=davinci_nand.1
mtdparts=mtdparts=davinci_nand.1:16k(env),1008k(dspboot),256k(env2),512k(uboot_a),512k(uboot_b),-(ubi)
bootargs_base=console=ttyS1,115200n8 mem=56M panic=5 ubi.mtd=5 rootfstype=squashfs ro
bootargs_extra=
bootslot_root=if test "${slot}" = b; then setenv rootdev /dev/mtdblock9; else setenv rootdev /dev/mtdblock8; fi
bootslot_one=run bootslot_root; ubi read ${loadaddr} kernel_${slot} && setenv bootargs ${bootargs_base} root=${rootdev} osiris.slot=${slot} ${bootargs_extra} && bootm ${loadaddr}
